name: hae
description: Hae, a warm and proud young male idol hunter for kids, leader of the patrol: tall, broad-shouldered, dark indigo hair in a neat high ponytail with a small gold tie, bright brown eyes, friendly grin. Wears a gold tailcoat-style jacket with a high black collar, gold trim and a small lantern pin on the lapel, a black vest with gold buttons, a white shirt and black tie, black fingerless gloves, black trousers and black boots. Chibi-anime style, clean outlines, no logos.
notes: arms relaxed at the sides, nothing held in the hands, the outfit the same on both sides
